verdict.rationale: Datadog documents official Agent Observability SDKs for Python and Node.js, with automatic and manual instrumentation APIs (e.g., ddtrace-run for Python). The evidence is scoped to LLM/agent observability rather than general application tracing, and TypeScript is not named explicitly. Missing for 10: documentation of general-purpose APM tracing SDKs for Python and JS/TS, explicit TypeScript support, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK instrumentation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs

citations.quote: SDKs are available for Python, Node.js, Java, and Go (experimental).
This page demonstrates using Datadog's Agent Observability SDK to instrument a Python, Node.js, or Java LLM application.
Agent Observability SDKs provide automatic instrumentation as well as manual instrumentation APIs
Enable Agent Observability by running your application using the `ddtrace-run` command
